**Overall T03 verdict: PASS.** Both T-2 defects from the prior independent verdict are fixed in the current working-tree candidate based on `2719c36dbcf506d888279b8e408bafd6b3f9250f`. I retested on Node v24.22.3, macOS arm64, using temporary fixtures and local provider stubs.

| Case | Exit | Observed outcome |
|---|---:|---|
| Same ID, earlier `at` (`2020-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`) | 1 | Rejected with a start-time conflict. All 4 P001 rows were byte-identical. |
| Same ID, later `at` (`2030-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`) | 1 | Rejected with the same conflict. All 4 P001 rows were byte-identical. |
| Same ID, identical row | 0 | Replay succeeded. P001 stayed at 4 byte-identical rows and retained the original `at` of `2026-11-26T13:20:03.618Z`. |
| P002 review, absolute `--out` to P001’s ledger | 2 | `invalid_request`. Zero reviewer launches, zero P002 call or review rows, and all 4 P001 rows were byte-identical. |
| P002 review, relative `--out` to P001’s ledger | 2 | Same rejection and counts. After both attempts, P001 stats still reported `recorded` with 4 attempts. |
| P002 review, `--out` to an ordinary JSON file | 0 | One reviewer launch, one P002 call row, and one P002 review row. The output verdict was `pass`, and the call row linked to `review-records/R1.json`. All 4 P001 rows were byte-identical. |

The targeted Node run exited **0** with **2 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, 0 cancelled, 0 todo**. The synthetic checks passed **6 of 6 after correcting one fixture assertion**. The initial run scored 5 of 6 because the assertion looked for the record reference in the `--out` copy. The isolated recheck verified the reference against CLI stdout and the review ledger and confirmed that the output copy matched the stored record.

The prior independent evidence carries forward for T-1, T-3, T-4’s verified cases, and the remaining T-2 behavior. That evidence includes 105 passes and 1 Windows-only skip in the bounded suite, plus 3 passes in the permission-scope checks. The full close and retrospective workflow, live providers, and Windows remain outside runtime verification. The source and original worktree were unchanged.
